headline: Gadi Eisenkot Receives Arab-Led Parties Support For Israeli Premiership
seoTitle: Gadi Eisenkot Gains Support For Israeli Leadership
metaDescription: Gadi Eisenkot has secured endorsements from Arab-led parties to form a government as Benjamin Netanyahu faces waning support from coalition allies.
aiSummaryBullets: Gadi Eisenkot has secured support from Arab-majority parties to potentially form the next Israeli government.
Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition faces internal pressure after a primary ultra-Orthodox ally declined to recommend his candidacy.
President Isaac Herzog is expected to decide which candidate will be tasked with building a government on Sunday.
aiContextParagraph: Following the recent inconclusive general election, political maneuvering in Israel has intensified as potential leaders seek to assemble a governing coalition. Gadi Eisenkot has emerged as a primary challenger to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu after obtaining endorsements from the Joint List and Ra’am, two parties representing Arab-majority constituencies. This development follows a shift in support among Netanyahu’s traditional base, specifically an ultra-Orthodox party that opted not to back the incumbent. While Eisenkot has reportedly garnered backing from 67 lawmakers, President Isaac Herzog maintains the authority to decide who will be mandated to attempt the formation of the next government. The president has stated that he will announce his decision on Sunday, as the country navigates an ongoing period of legislative uncertainty and deadlock regarding the future leadership of the nation.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to the significant shift in parliamentary backing for the premiership and its potential to end Benjamin Netanyahu’s tenure.
